name: Langers 100% Pure Pear Juice
whyItWorks: Pure pear juice provides natural hydration and mild fructose/glucose balance with very low acid. Pear is known to be one of the least allergenic and least irritating fruits for the human gut.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour 4 oz over a tall glass of ice and top with filtered cold water. Refreshing and gentle on sensitive stomachs.
